description: Highlight files and lines relative to a fixed Git commit without changing Git state.
config.repository: Optional repository directory, absolute or relative to the active workspace folder. Empty automatically discovers the active Git repository.
config.base: Optional commit, tag, or branch. Changing this value resolves and freezes the commit; refresh does not follow moving references. Leave empty to select a baseline using the command.
config.showGutterIcons: Show baseline gutter icons. Disabled by default to keep Git gutter marks clear.
config.showOverviewRuler: Show baseline marks in the overview ruler. Disabled by default to keep Git marks clear.
config.showFileBadges: Show N/M baseline file badges. Disabled by default to keep Git file badges clear.
